options.name: address
options.description: IP or hostname of the backend (only resolved on start-up.)

options.name: advanced
options.description: Allows for adding custom HAProxy settings to the server. These are passed as written, use escaping where needed.

options.name: ca
options.description: SSL servers only, set the CA authority to check the server certificate against.

options.name: checkssl
options.description: This can be used with for example a LDAPS health-checks where LDAPS is passed along with mode TCP

options.name: clientcert
options.description: SSL servers only, This certificate will be sent if the server send a client certificate request.

options.name: cookie
options.description: Persistence only, Used to identify server when cookie persistence is configured for the backend.

options.name: crl
options.description: SSL servers only, set the CRL to check revoked certificates.

options.name: forwardto
options.description: The name of the frontend to forward. When None, forwards to address and port

options.name: istemplate
options.description: If set, configures this server item as a template to provision servers from dns/srv responses.

options.name: maxconn
options.description: Tuning, If the number of incoming concurrent requests goes higher than this value, they will be queued

options.name: ssl
options.description: Should haproxy encrypt the traffic to the backend with SSL (commonly used with mode http on frontend and a port 443 on backend).

options.name: sslserververify
options.description: SSL servers only, The server certificate will be verified against the CA and CRL certificate configured below.

options.name: state
options.description: State in which to leave the backend server

options.name: verifyhost
options.description: SSL servers only, when set, must match the hostnames in the subject and subjectAlternateNames of the certificate provided by the server.

options.name: weight
options.description: A weight between 0 and 256, this setting can be used when multiple servers on different hardware need to be balanced with a different part the traffic. A server with weight 0 wont get new traffic. Default if empty: 1
